preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the number of vertices n must be between 1 and 400,000, and the number of edges m must be between 0 and 400,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of integers representing the path counts for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(result in {-1, 0, 1, 2} for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result must be one of the valid path count values: -1, 0, 1, or 2.
The number of results must match the number of vertices n.
